spans.s: चिल् [cil], 6 P. (चिलति) To put on clothes.
चिलमी (मि) लिका A kind of necklace.
Lightning. चिलि(ली)चि(ची)मः, -मिः, चिलीमः, चेलचीमः A kind of fish. Charak advises that this fish should not be eaten with milk (Mar. 'वेगसा' मासा.)
To become loose, be slack or flaccid.
ल्लः A bleared or sored eye.
The (Bengal) kite; चिल्ला also in this sense; बन्धनभ्रष्टो गृहकपोतश्चिल्लाया मुखे पतितः
; cf. English "From the frying-pan into the fire". -Comp. -आभः a petty thief, a pick-pocket.
चिल्लका [cillakā] चिल्लिका [cillikā] चिल्ली [cillī], चिल्लिका चिल्ली A cricket; cf. झिल्लिका.
चिल्लभक्ष्या [cillabhakṣyā], f. A prostitute; L. D. B.
